title: Ordinary normalized scalar restrictions for diagonal trace coefficients
statement: Fix a prime l, E=ULift Q_l, a scheme morphism f:X→S and localizations at X and S [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models]. Given coefficient-system Base b and its normalized geometric operations g over f [def-sp-tower-shriek-data], and normalized Chern data cS,cX [def-sp-tower-class-chern], there exist exact Restrictions rS,rX retaining all underlying sections, restrictions, transitions, maps and the residue action [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models], together with Coefficients records for cS,cX [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-coefficients]. The ordinary functors g.push ⋙ rS.F and rX.F ⋙ diagonalTraceSystemPush l f are naturally isomorphic by a map that is heterogeneously the identity on every section at every level. Also diagonalTracePush l f ⋙ diagonalCompletedRestriction l S and diagonalCompletedRestriction l X ⋙ lowerStar f are naturally isomorphic, with the same sectionwise identity normalization. No right derived functor or derived square is part of this assertion.

proof.text: Apply exists_diagonalTraceCoefficientRestriction separately at S and X with the given normalized Chern data. This supplies both exact Restrictions and their Coefficients records, before considering direct image.
Apply diagonalTraceVaryingScalarSquare to g and these two supplied Restrictions to obtain the varying square and its sectionwise identity.

Use diagonalTraceCompletedScalarSquare, proved directly from finite coefficient projections and constant-sheaf naturality, for the completed square. Assemble the two coefficient records and the two normalized ordinary squares in the original existential order.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_diagonalTraceOrdinaryScalars (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)))
    (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) b f)
    (cS : Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) S)
    (cX : Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) X)
    (nS : cS.Normalized l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)))
    (nX : cX.Normalized l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)))
    :
    let E := ULift.{u} (Padic l)
    ∃ (rS : Restriction l E S) (rX : Restriction l E X),
      letI : rS.F.Additive := rS.additive
      letI : rX.F.Additive := rX.additive
      letI : PreservesFiniteLimits rS.F := rS.limits
      letI : PreservesFiniteColimits rS.F := rS.colimits
      letI : PreservesFiniteLimits rX.F := rX.limits
      letI : PreservesFiniteColimits rX.F := rX.colimits
      Nonempty (Coefficients l E S cS rS) ∧
      Nonempty (Coefficients l E X cX rX) ∧
      ∃ varyingOrdinary : g.push ⋙ rS.F ≅ rX.F ⋙ diagonalTraceSystemPush l f,
      ∃ varying_sections : ∀ (M : Systems X (Arings l E X)) (n : ℕ) (U : S.ProEtᵒᵖ)
          (x : (((g.push ⋙ rS.F).obj M).obj (op n)).obj.obj U),
        HEq (((varyingOrdinary.hom.app M).app (op n)).hom.app U x) x,
      ∃ completedOrdinary : diagonalTracePush l f ⋙ diagonalCompletedRestriction l S ≅
        diagonalCompletedRestriction l X ⋙
          lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ_[l])) f,
      ∀ (M : DiagonalCompleted l X) (U : S.ProEtᵒᵖ)
          (x : ((diagonalTracePush l f ⋙ diagonalCompletedRestriction l S).obj M).obj.obj U),
        HEq ((completedOrdinary.hom.app M).hom.app U x) x
